feynman_certification.listener_verdict: The hook was solid—I've definitely felt the pain of KV cache re-prefilling when building agents, so you had me immediately. I like that you didn't waste time with a 'Hey guys' intro. My only issue is that 'AKV Cache' sounds like a specific library or paper, but you didn't explain if it's a technique or a tool I can actually use. Also, 'surgically drop tokens' is a cool visual, but I'm curious how you handle the position encoding shift without breaking the attention mechanism.

thriller_metadata.physical_analogy: A library index card system where changing one entry forces you to rewrite the entire catalog.
thriller_metadata.paradigm_shift: Stateless interface for stateful cache management
